balls.text: full down the leg side but Padikkal has exposed his stumps once again. Goes over midwicket, the bottom hand coming off the handle. And they comes back for the third. Dhoni snaps at Dube once again for him failing to be proactive and stop the third with a weak throw

Padikkal backs away big time and the bowler follows him. Misses the flick and the ball brushes the pads. Goes fine enough to beat fine leg for four more. Or was there some bat involved? Looks like this has been given as runs
a full toss. Hits Ashwin's bat than the other way round and goes towards deep third
151.4kph. Full but down the leg side. Padikkal fails to get his bat on it but they look to sneak in a bye. Dhoni nails the direct with an underarm throw to find Jurel well short
length ball around off. Steered towards deep cover for one
138.3kph - that looked like his slower one. More luck for Royals. Full around off, Jurel looks to launch it over long-on but gets an outside edge over short third for another boundary
A yorker gone wrong. Ends up as a full toss down the leg side. And Jurel pulls it over fine leg for a six
full and wide and Jurel hits it hard towards deep extra cover. Only a single this time, though
full around off, an offcutter at 119.1kph. Jurel spots it and launches it over long-on for a six
full outside off and Jurel drills it down the ground for four. Excellent shot
length outside off. Throws his bat at it, gets an inside edge towards fine leg
full and wide outside off. Throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Royals have reviewed it for a wide. Just inside the guide line, so it stays a legal ball
139.1kph. Full and wide outside off. Padikkal moves across and just helps it past short fine leg for four
yorker again. Squeezes it out towards extra cover for one
nails another yorker but ends up conceding another boundary, this time an inside edge to the left of fine leg
149.9kph. Another yorker, and Padikkal gets lucky this time. He is standing deep in the crease and pushes at it. Gets a thick outside edge past the keeper
full and wide. Throws his bat at it to slice it over cover
another attempted yorker but ends up bowling a high full toss. Punched towards mid-off where Conway tumbles over the ball and concedes an extra run
a yorker on the middle stump. 145kph. Padikkal digs it out down the ground for one
length ball on the stumps. Padikkal gets an inside edge through his legs. A single to backward square leg
full on the stumps, pushed towards long-off
carrom ball again, pitching around leg and beating the inside edge to hit the pads. A mild appeal for lbw; it was heading down
offbreak this time. Full on the pads. Padikkal sweeps it over backward square leg for a one-bounce four
103.8kph. Another carrom ball, around off. Padikkal goes for the cut and chops it into the ground
chopped on. Was a carrom ball, just outside off. Hetmyer went for the cut but there's hardly any room. Gets a bottom edge onto his stumps
149.5kph. Another wide yorker and Jurel fails to get his bat on it
length ball outside off, punched towards sweeper cover
a bouncer this time. Jurel goes for the pull but gets a top edge that sails over Dhoni for four

short of length at the batter, 137.5kph but came much slower off the pitch. Hetmyer was through his pull before the ball reached him. Gets hit on the body and the ball dribbles to the right of Dhoni. They sneak in a leg-bye. Dhoni collects the ball with the intention of a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the bowler was right in the middle of the pitch, and also in the way of the throw. Dhoni isn't happy with that
another yorker outside off. Swinging away as well slightly. Once again no bat from Hetmyer
a wide yorker. Hetmyer fails to get his bat on it
full on the pads, flicked towards midwicket
length ball on the stumps. Punched towards long-on
length ball on the stumps. Punched towards wide long-on
length ball on the pads. Tucked away towards deep square leg. Hetmyer puts in the slide to make his ground for the second run
length ball around off. Punched towards sweeper cover
length ball on the stumps. Goes back and pulls it towards deep-backward square leg
length ball around off. Pushed towards mid-off

129kph. A length ball outside off, was angling away from Jaiswal who is standing deep in the crease. He clears his front leg and looks to go aerial. Fails to middle it and Rahane settles under the swirler after taking a couple steps back at backward point
length outside off. Jaiswal backs away and cuts it to the left of Dube at sweeper cover for four
full outside off. Driven towards sweeper cover
length ball around off. Hetmyer defends it towards sweeper cover and they come back for the second. Dhoni isn't happy with his fielders for allowing that second run

and he strikes immediately. It was an offcutter at 126kph. A length ball around off that Samson looked to hit over long-on. Didn't middle it and Gaikwad takes an easy catch well inside the long-on boundary
length ball on the pads, worked in front of square leg for one
107.4kph. Short of length at the stumps. Samson rocks back and pulls it over short midwicket, and to the left of the fielder in the deep
length ball around off. Pulls it towards wide long-on
length outside off. Smashes it off the back foot but finds cover
down the track but Jadeja has darted it across the left-hander. Jaiswal ends up slicing it over backward point
length ball around off, from around the stumps. Jaiswal plays the sweep in front of square leg, to the left of the diving deep midwicket for four
132.5kph. Short of length outside off, Samson goes for the pull but the ball comes slower off the pitch and keeps low as well. Sneaks underneath bat
another excellent stop, this time by Conway running to his right and putting in a tumbling stop at deep cover boundary. Was a length ball outside off and Samson had smashed it off the back foot
full around off. Throws his bat at it, gets an inside edge towards square leg where Akash Singh fumbles and allows the second run
149kph. Short and skiddy. Jaiswal goes for the pull but gets hit on the glove. The ball falls near backward square leg
an excellent stop by Jadeja. It was full around off, and Jaiswal give himself room to scythe it to the right of deep cover. Jadeja sprints and flicks it back
full but down the leg side. Jaiswal looks to paddle it away but cannot reach there
length ball around off. Drags it towards long-on
length ball on the stumps. Pushed to the left of Jadeja who dives but can only get a hand to it. Extra cover tidies it up
length outside off. Cuts it towards deep point for another single
length ball on the stumps, punched towards long-on
length ball on the pads. Worked towards short midwicket
length ball on the stumps. Samson was looking to go back but has little time to play a shot. This was bowled at 102.2kph and Samson ends up just defending it
short of length outside off. Cuts it towards deep point
length ball spinning in sharply. Samson stays back and leg side of the ball. Opens the face late to work it towards short third
length ball around off and spinning in. Turned towards wide mid-on. The fielder is at the boundary line, and the batters come back for the second
length ball on the stumps, goes back and pushes it towards long-on
goes for the sweep this time but it's too short. He was through the shot even before the ball arrived
uses his feet, gives himself some room and goes inside out over extra cover for a six. 86 metres
length ball around off. Stays back and pushes it towards sweeper cover
length ball on the stumps. Worked towards short midwicket with soft hands from the back foot
length outside off. Goes for the cut but it's too close. Chopped into the ground
length ball on the pads from around the stumps. Flicked towards deep square leg
full on the stumps, pushed towards long-off
length all down the leg side. Samson misses the flick
Jadeja provides the breakthrough. Buttler uses his feet, looking to clear long-on but the bat face closes, resulting in a simple catch for Dube
looks to come down the track but Jadeja shortens his length. Chopped towards extra cover. Jaiswal sets off, Buttler responds and beats the throw even though Dhoni flicks it onto the stumps
length outside off. Buttler isn't to the pitch of the ball, so ends up pushing at it. Gets beaten on the outside edge. Dhoni breaks the stumps but no appeal
length outside off. Goes for the cut but it's too wide
length ball around off. Worked towards midwicket
dropped. Another sharp offbreak. Buttler was on the back foot, looking to push it on the off side. Gets a big inside edge that hits Dhoni's pads and dribbles towards short fine leg
length ball on the pads, tucked away towards midwicket for a couple
length outside off. Spins back sharply to beat Butter's inside edge, the off stump and Dhoni's gloves. Buttler was looking to hit it through covers but gets four byes instead
length ball around off. Cuts it towards sweeper cover
101.6kph. A length ball around off. Hits it towards long-on and gets to his fifty, off just 26 balls
length outside off. Cuts it behind point for two more
length ball around off, and Jaiswal brings out the reverse hit. Goes over backward point, and clears the boundary with each. A 69-metre six
full on the stumps, driven towards long-off
down the track but Jadeja shortens his length. Jaiswal adjusts and flicks it towards midwicket
length ball around off. Cuts it towards cover-point
length ball around off, and Buttler ends the over as he had started. Hits it over the bowler's head off the back foot. Gaikwad runs to his left from long-on but he knows he cannot stop it
too full on the stumps. Buttler digs it out towards mid-off but no run
length ball on the pads, spinning. Tucked away towards forward square leg
full on the pads. Misses the full on gets on the pads. Pitched outside leg
length ball on the stumps, pushed towards long-on with soft hands, but will get only a single
length ball at the stumps, looked like a carrom ball. Buttler stays back and just forces it over the bowler's head. Too straight for long-on to cut off
length ball on the pads, flicked in front of square leg for a couple
length ball on the stumps. Defended from the back foot
length ball outside off. Finds the cover fielder with the cut
length ball, just around off. Defended back
into the stands. Short, and then down the leg side. Jaiswal pulls it over deep square leg for a six. The square boundaries are just 66 metres, by the way
length ball outside off, pushed towards extra cover for a single
length ball on the stumps, punched back. Just three from that over, including a leg-bye
length ball around off. Turned towards wide long-on but only a single
length around off. Buttler forces it towards extra cover off the back foot

short of length at the stumps. Jaiswal goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the front pad. An appeal for lbw. The ball deflects towards short third, and they sneak in a run. But CSK have sent it upstairs. Replays show that the ball pitched just outside leg, so CSK lose their first review
length ball on the pads. Jaiswal looks to flick it away but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls towards short fine
starts with a length ball around off. Buttler goes back and works it towards deep midwicket
116.6kph. Slower one but too short. Jaiswal stays back and cuts it past backward point for yet another boundary
slightly fuller than good length, outside off. And Jaiswal goes after it, smashing it between cover and point for four
down the track and backs away big time but Akash follows him. Jaiswal goes for a pull but gloves it towards short fine
launched over long-on. A length ball at the stumps. Not much room to free the arms but Jaiswal picks it up over long-on for the first six of the night. 83 metres
131.7kph. A bouncer from Akash. Jaiswal was looking to come on the front foot but had to sway away in the end
streaky. Jaiswal goes down the track this time but is cramped by a length ball on middle and leg. Gets an inside edge that beats short fine to his left
146.9kph. Length ball around, Buttler quickly skips towards the ball but can only push it towards short cover

finds the gap this time. Think that's what he was trying to do on the previous too occasions as well. Length outside off, and Buttler opens the face of the bat to steer it between the slip and short third
145.8kph. A length ball outside off this time. Buttler once again pushes at it. Once again he gets beaten
once again the use of feet from Buttler. This time it's short of length outside off. Buttler pushes at it and gets beaten
length ball at the stumps. Buttler once again walks towards the bowler and flicks it behind square leg
length ball outside off, and here's Buttler showing his class. Just takes a step and half towards the ball and just pushes it to the left of extra cover for his first boundary
length ball angling across Buttler who steers it towards deep extra cover
length ball on the pads, flicked away once again towards midwicket but this time he couldn't middle it. Just a single
Akash once again errs on the fuller side. This time it's too straight, on middle and leg, and Jaiswal just flicks it the the left of short midwicket for the third four of the over
length ball on the stumps this time, defended towards mid-on

back-to-back fours. Akash pulls his length but just a little bit, looking for that swing. It does shape away from Jaiswal but he presents the full face of the bat and sends it between extra cover and mid-off
Too full outside off, and Jaiswal goes down on one knee and smashes it through covers. Four to get off the mark

picks out long-on! Buttler couldn't have asked for an easier catch. Kuldip finishes the over with another excellent ball. Full, wide and away from Dube's hitting arc, he goes for it and toe-ends it to the fielder.  Royals have done the double over CSK this season, they go top of the table.
drags this from outside off towards deep midwicket, Jaiswal runs around the ropes and puts his left hand out to stop that
bowls a wide Yorker, Dube can't get underneath the length again, squeezed to deep cover. Superb bowling
hit hard down the ground but straight to long-off
that's hit straight but no timing, drops short of long-off
beaten as he swings this full delivery. Perhaps it was the slower one too. Game's beyond CSK now unless there's a wide or no-ball.
fetch that! Gets underneath the length and blasts that over the bowler's head. Super straight hit to the boundary.
Yorker-length, dug out to long-off.  Third consecutive half-century for Dube
drilled straight to long-off

beaten as he attempts to sweep Holder off his length. Was looking to fetch it from way outside off. Samson has reviewed for a possible under-edge, but it's as very optimistic one. No one's really celebrating.
reaches out to scythe this into the gap at deep cover for two more
hit hard to sweeper cover
crunched! This is a high full toss that Jadeja swings into the gap at deep square. Absolutely nailed that.
toe-ends this lofted hit, the ball dribbles to deep cover
pulled straight to deep square
swung away wide of long-on for four! Jadeja took this on the full and hit it really hard.
gets a thick edge past the keeper, but short third is very fine precisely for this, just a single
hit hard but straight to long-off

picks the gap! This is incredible from Dube. Holder doesn't think he's done much wrong in bowling a wide yorker again but Dube reaches out and opens the bat face to pick this gap between short third and point. Outstanding stuff.
swept from outside off to deep midwicket
low full toss, drills it to sweeper cover
scythed behind point, the timing is so good that it races away even though deep point wasn't far from the ball. Zampa there has a bemused look because he knew he was this close to the ball.
spears a wide-worker, Dube lets it pass assuming it'll be called wide but this one's just inside the wide line.
bludgeoned down the ground!Stand and deliver stuff right out of the top drawer. Holder sprays this full and across but it's well within Dube's swinging arc as he absolutely belts this up and over.
drilled to deep cover. Outstanding over from Sandeep
sways out of the way of this short ball outside off, strange call that to bail out. Signaled one short ball for the over
nails another ripper of a yorker, dug out to long-on
right into the blockhole, squeezed out to the bowler.
no power or timing behind that slap, long-off comes rushing in to try and grab that but has to settle for stopping it on the bounce
short of length on off, Jadeja dabs behind point for a single
works it down to long-on to get off the mark
there's the thick underedge and Moeen is gone. This is pushed through quicker and away from Moeen as he reaches out to belt that through the off side. Excellent catch from Samson.
straight hit, superb hit! Excellent use of his feet to get to the pitch as he launched it over Zampa's head.
beauty! Beaten by the drift and zip. Moeen was looking to dab it behind square on the off side
drilled down to a straightish long-off
he's clobbered that into the stands! Too full, right into Dube's striking zone. They need more of that.
slaps this short of length delivery to long-off
goes length outside off, away from Dube's reach, mistimed back to the bowler
driven firmly down the ground to long-off again
fired full, drilled to long-off
this one's hammered over deep midwicket! CSK are on the move. Ashwin bowls this quicker but bowls too short in the process, Dube is waiting on the back foot as he wallops this. What power.
how big is that? Very, very big.  Right in his hitting arc as Dube belts that over the ropes at long-on. Super hit that.
slashed away for four! Too much width outside off, Moeen gets enough bat on it as it dribbles past short third.
swept over deep backward square! Swung that away with the spin. Chahal tossed it up nicely, Moeen picked his spot and hit it sweetly
bunted gently into the off side for a single
slides one across the left-hander, not called wide
bowls a front-of-the-hand slider wide outside off, Dube slaps this into the gap at long-off for two
width and he's slapped this to deep point
tucks this to midwicket for an easy single
good, clean strike for six! Leans forward, the balance is impeccable as he lofts through the line to clear long-off effortlessly.
gets bat on ball as Holder goes yorker on middle, down to long-off
tucks it to short fine for a quick single
tucks it off his hip to square leg
surprises him with pace and bounce as he goes short, Dube was looking tot take him on with the hook but is beaten for pace and bails out. Umpire deems it too high and signals wide.
pushed through quicker on off, defended to cover. Top over
defended to short cover

nails the slog sweep straight to Holder at deep midwicket.  Holder for a second appeared to have run across a bit too far, but recovered nicely to keep his balance and take the catch. Rayudu didn't field all evening, comes in as an Impact Sub and lasts all of two balls. Ashwin is pumped, Royals are all over CSK.
flatter one on a length, pushed back

Rahane has hit this straight down long-on's throat. He steps out to loft, but Ashwin bowls a drifter into him, Rahane thinks he's hit it into the gap but sees Buttler cover good ground to his right to get to the ball and take an excellent catch.
punched to long-off
struck on the pad as this pitches outside leg and fizzes through. Stifled appeal, but everyone knew where that pitched. Superb bowling from Zampa
cuts but picks out point
lofted to long-off, no timing that time
whips this full toss to deep midwicket

that's a wicket well deserved. Beats Gaikwad in flight as he looks to go downtown. Because there's a hint of turn, he ends up getting a top-edge. Padikkal sprints in from long-on, keeps his eyes on the ball all along and completes an excellent catch.
steps out to swing it over long-on but turns out to be a flat hit to the fielder. Didn't get the elevation
worked towards deep midwicket
steps out, Ashwin bowls full on leg, pushed down to long-on
whips this down to long-on
chipped down the ground, Parag at long-off ran in quickly and threw himself forward in attempting the catch. But couldn't get his hands underneath the ball. Full marks for the effort from Parag
flat hit into the gap at wide long-off, outstanding work there by substitute fielder Parag. Covered about 20 yards and then threw himself full stretch to cut that off, saved two runs for the side.
whips this into the gap towards the man running across diagonally from deep midwicket, excellent running to come back for the second
nails this one! Short of length but because he rolled his finger across the seam, it took a while getting to the other end. Gaikwad though held his shape and muscled it into the gap when it arrived.
takes him on with the pull, hits it well but straight to deep square
width outside off, Rahane steers this to deep point, singles won't bother Royals at all
clean lofted hit down to long-off, there's protection there
gentle nudge into the leg side as they complete a quick single again
looks to tuck it through square on the leg side, gets a thick inside edge to short fine
punched down to long-on again
flatter and fuller, pushed to long-off
pushed straight to cover
punches to long-on, off the mark immediately
works this to wide long-on
off a thick edge and it races past short third! Gaikwad rocks back to cut but there's no room to work with, still went through and got away with it.
picks out mid-off! Conway just didn't look a part tonight. Got to the pitch and hit it flat but found Sandeep Sharma.
whips this full toss one bounce to mid-on for a single
pulled but no room for the free swing, hit one bounce to deep midwicket. Conway is struggling
Yorker-length on off, squeezed to cover
steps out and punches to mid-on, since he was on the move, completes the single easily
it's the flipper that Gaikwad has no clue about but still manages to get an inside edge that flies past leg stump and into the boundary.
this one keeps a tad low, Conway gets the bottom part of the bat as he cuts, they take a quick single.
wrists this shortish delivery into the gap at wide long-on, two more.
goes over cover and the ball just about bounces short of the rope!  Didn't get to the pitch, was also hitting it into the wind but got enough bat on it to pick the boundary.
fired full on the stumps, squeezed past mid-on as they scamper back for the second
turns it back to the bowler, good stop on his followthrough
steps out and punches this shortish delivery to long-off
ooh dear!  That's been walloped over deep backward square leg.  Gift of a delivery from Holder - a high full toss angling down, Gaikwad swung that away and the ball sailed all the way.
slapped over the infield! Makes room and takes on this short ball as he swings this over mid-on. Welcome boundary.
chipped in the air, lands short of mid-on but they scamper a single
pulls and misses. Looked to fetch it from outside off.
spears a Yorker-length delivery outside off, Conway late on the shot as he tries to squeeze this behind point
steers it to short third as they scamper a quick single
firm push but can't pick the gap at mid-off. Tight over
pushed straight to midwicket, tight bowling this
looks to back away and loft over cover, but ends up getting an inside edge onto the pad. Pressure building
sliding down leg from around the stumps, tucked straight to short fine leg
backs away and exposes all three stumps, Sandeep targets the base of off, Gaikwad squeezes this Yorker-length off the inner half of the bat to mid-on
backs away, Sandeep follows him with a length ball to tuck him up, defended back
firm push between cover and point for a single.

Chahal has put down a tough chance running back from short third.  It was an absolute swirler, Chahal had to run back, he was also circling beneath the ball. The wind also took the ball further away. Back to the shot, Gaikwad was trying to pull but was beaten by the skid off the pitch. Two lives for him. Some luck that

leading edge but it lands safely! Gaikwad gets a life. Kuldip bowls short of length, the ball seems to have stopped on him a touch as Gaikwad is looking to nudge it into the leg side. Was in the air for a while
Buttler saves a certain boundary! Driven firmly, Buttler throws himself to his left at mid-off to keep that to a single.
punched into the covers for a quick single
crunching cover drive but finds the fielder. Gets away with a half-volley

whipped wide of mid-on! That's a Conway special. There's an element of wrist and hand-eye involved. Generates tremendous power to that length ball on middle-and-off. Terrific stroke. There's an air of nonchalance to him when he plays that stroke. Almost dismissive of the bowler.
walks down the pitch to try and throw the bowler off his lengths but Sandeep hits hard lengths nonetheless, Conway turns this straight to midwicket
doesn't commit fully forward again, defends from the crease as the ball nearly rolls back onto the stumps. Excellent from Sandeep
beauty! It's the late movement away that beats Conway's feeble push
bends one back in off a length on middle-and-off, Gaikwad pushes it back down the pitch for a single
late inward movement from outside off, Gaikwad gets a thickish inside edge down to deep backward square leg
